0: Ordinance – Installation and upkeep of city water meters City of Santa Claus, Georgia The Council of the City of Santa Claus hereby ordains: 1- All water meters shall be installed by the City and shall be located on city right-of-way as granted by easement. 2 - Single-unit dwelling shall have one (1) meter. Multi-unit dwellings shall have one (1) meter for each unit within the complex. (Clarification – One (1) Meter for each apartment or trailer.) 3 - Each meter shall be attached to a single line extending from the city main water line to the meter. 4 - No meter shall serve more than one (1) line from the meter to the structure being served. Motels are the only exclusion and they may be served by one meter. 5 - The City shall be responsible for the repairs up to and including the meter. No repairs shall be made by the City beyond the meter or on private property. All meters located on privately owned property shall be the sole responsibility of the property owner. 6 - All existing installations of city water meters in violation of this ordinance, as adopted shall be brought to compliance. 7 - Violators of this ordinance shall be subject to a fine of no less than one hundred fifty ($150.00) dollars. 8 - A fee of seventy-five ($75.00) dollars shall be paid to the City prior to installation. Fee shall be non-refundable. 9 - Any and all prior ordinances, if such exist, pertaining to installation and upkeep of city water meters are hereby repealed.
